**[P2] Preserve monotonic span durations**

Sampling `Date.now()` independently for starts and ends makes live SDK spans depend on an adjustable wall clock. If the host clock moves backward during an invocation, an operation or invocation can end before it started, and a default user span—which measures elapsed time monotonically—can again end after its SDK parent. Anchor the epoch to `Date.now()` once but advance boundaries with a monotonic clock (or otherwise derive ends from monotonic elapsed time), and add a backward-clock test.
